title: Ali and the Bus
text:
Ali needs a map of the city. He opens the map on his phone. The map shows the bus station in the center. There is a red line for the number 5 bus.

The timetable is on the wall at the bus stop. It shows the time of each bus. The number 5 bus leaves at 9:15 in the morning. Ali walks to the station and waits for the bus.

questions.text: What color is the line for the number 5 bus on the map?
What time does the number 5 bus leave?
Why does Ali look at the timetable?
options: To find out when the bus leaves
To find the bus driver's name

questions.text: What can we infer about Ali's plan?
options: He wants to take the number 5 bus
He wants to buy a map
He wants to drive a car
He wants to sleep at the bus stop

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows roads and places
a list that shows when buses or trains leave
a place where buses or trains stop
stays in one place until something happens

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin şehrin bir haritasına ihtiyacı var. Telefonunda haritayı açar. Harita, merkezdeki otobüs istasyonunu gösterir. 5 numaralı otobüs için kırmızı bir çizgi vardır.
Sefer saatleri çizelgesi durağın duvarındadır. Her otobüsün saatini gösterir. 5 numaralı otobüs sabah saat 09:15'te kalkar. Ali istasyona yürür ve otobüsü bekler.
